---- MODULE MultiShardTxnSnapshot ----
EXTENDS MultiShardTxnSnapshotDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL ProofMethods == INSTANCE TLAPS
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM SnapshotIsolationCorrect ==
    (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) => []SnapshotIsolation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => SnapshotIsolation
    BY ProofMethods!SMTT("r30") DEF Init, SnapshotIsolation,
       CC!SnapshotIsolation, CC!satisfyIsolationLevel,
       CC!executions, CC!CT_SI
<1>2. SnapshotIsolation /\ SingleWritePerKey /\
       [Next]_vars /\ SingleWritePerKey' => SnapshotIsolation'
    BY ProofMethods!SMTT("r30") DEF SnapshotIsolation, SingleWritePerKey,
       WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce, Next
<1>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, ProofMethods!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
====
